prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which player who scored more than 10 goals in the 2022 Argentine Premier League season also played for Elche in Spain?
answer: None. The players who scored more than 10 goals in Argentina’s 2022 Primera División—primarily Mateo Retegui and Enzo Copetti—did not play for Elche. Elche’s Argentine players included Ezequiel Ponce and Darío Benedetto, but neither scored more than 10 league goals in Argentina’s 2022 season.
